snippet.title: Confronted Chapter 2 - Available Now
snippet.description:
Confronted: Chapter 1 & 2 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2882610/Confronted/

Outsmart what hunts you. Build your hideouts. Plan each escape. As Dorinela, a survivor returning to face her abuser’s curse, use your wits to stay alive within this cursed gothic castle.
